content.text: Forbidden Island is a cooperative commercial board and card game where players race to recover treasures and escape before a sinking island disappears.
Designed by Matt Leacock and published by Gamewright Games in 2010, Forbidden Island uses decks of cards to drive flooding, treasure collection, and the rising danger level.
2-4 players use the table arrangement described for Forbidden Island.
Commercial Forbidden Island treasure and flood decks with island tiles and pawns
Commercial Forbidden Island treasure and flood decks with island tiles and pawns, score area, and enough table space for play.
Prepare Commercial Forbidden Island treasure and flood decks with island tiles and pawns and deal or lay out cards according to the documented Forbidden Island rules before play begins.
